outcome.answer: For LLM training, effective synthetic-data curation should account for how samples interact as groups: group-level utility signals can improve downstream performance, especially generative capability, where judging samples individually may miss important effects [1]. Other approaches include dynamically reweighting examples during training to improve generalization without removing data [3], and combining offline selection with online refinement of responses for fine-tuning [9]. For specialized-task dataset generation, AutoSynth automates the discovery and optimization of generation workflows without a reference dataset [4].
